notes.title: More language related fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

With this patch, we aim to address a few more language-related issues:
[list]
[*] The Chinese and Japanese translations have been completely revised
[*] "Daily Puzzle" should now display correctly in all languages
[*] Several typos have been fixed
[/list]
We appreciate your patience with us – have a wonderful holiday season!

notes.title: Hotfix for Japanese and Chinese characters
notes.content:
Hello!

Several players notified us that the in-game texts were not displayed correctly for our Japanese and Chinese players.

This hotfix should have taken care of this issue now.

Thank you for being so patient!
